objects.canonical_term: Centrally Assessed Property
objects.summary: Property classes valued by the state rather than locally, including centrally assessed/public-service property domains handled by PAD.
objects.plain_language: Some property is valued centrally by the state instead of by the county assessor.

relationships.note: Centrally assessed property is a state assessment domain adjacent to equalization.

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DOR PAD, State Assessed Property.
Nebraska DOR PAD, Title 350 Nebraska Administrative Code, ch. 30.

objects.canonical_term: Documentary Stamp Tax
objects.summary: Nebraska tax domain connected to recorded real estate transfer instruments and Title 350 Chapter 52.
objects.plain_language: This is a transfer-related tax tied to recorded real estate documents, not the annual valuation itself.

relationships.note: Transfer tax is distinct from annual property tax billing.

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DOR PAD, Title 350 Nebraska Administrative Code, ch. 52.

objects.canonical_term: Personal Property in Transit Exemption
objects.summary: Constitutional exemption category for qualifying personal property in transit in licensed warehouses or storage areas.
objects.plain_language: Certain property moving through Nebraska storage or warehouse channels may be constitutionally exempt from property tax.

relationships.note: Exemption applies to a defined personal-property category.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 2A.

objects.canonical_term: Payment in Lieu of Tax
objects.summary: A payment or tax substitute domain for certain public corporation or political subdivision property and electrical systems.
objects.plain_language: Some public or quasi-public property may pay a substitute amount instead of ordinary property tax.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 11.
Nebraska DOR PAD, Title 350 Nebraska Administrative Code, ch. 41.

objects.canonical_term: Tax Increment Financing
objects.summary: Nebraska constitutional and regulatory domain allowing legislatively authorized community redevelopment financing using incremental property tax value.
objects.plain_language: TIF separates part of the tax value growth for a redevelopment project under constitutional and statutory rules.

relationships.note: TIF affects tax allocation after valuation and levy mechanics.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 12.
Nebraska DOR PAD, Title 350 Nebraska Administrative Code, ch. 18.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-1B Income Tax
objects.summary: Article VIII section addressing continuation and limitation of Nebraska income tax authority; included for complete revenue article coverage.
objects.plain_language: This is a revenue section but usually not a property-assessment authority.

facts.object: Adopted 1966 via Laws 1965, LB 1022, constitutional amendment No. 3.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 1B.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-2A Personal Property in Transit Exemption
objects.summary: Article VIII section authorizing an exemption for personal property in transit through licensed warehouses or storage areas.
objects.plain_language: This is the constitutional home for the in-transit personal-property exemption.

facts.object: Adopted 1962 via Laws 1961, constitutional amendment No. 5.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 2A.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-3 Tax Sale Redemption
objects.summary: Article VIII section preserving a redemption period from sale of real estate for taxes or special assessments.
objects.plain_language: This is a constitutional tax-collection safeguard after property is sold for taxes or special assessments.

facts.object: Originated as Neb. Const. art. IX, sec. 4 (1875); amended 1920.

relationships.note: Tax collection and sale context follows assessment/levy.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 3.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-4 No Release or Commutation of Taxes
objects.summary: Article VIII section prohibiting release or commutation of taxes except under constitutionally recognized circumstances.
objects.plain_language: Taxes generally cannot just be forgiven unless an authorized exception applies.

facts.object: Originated as Neb. Const. art. IX, sec. 5 (1875); amended 1920 and 2012.

relationships.note: Authorized exceptions and substitutes require separate authority.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 4.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-5 County Taxes Limitation
objects.summary: Article VIII section limiting county taxes except as constitutionally authorized.
objects.plain_language: County taxing power is constitutionally limited and then implemented through statutes and levy processes.

facts.object: Originated as Neb. Const. art. IX, sec. 6 (1875); amended 1920 and 1966.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 5.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-6 Local Improvements and Municipal Taxes
objects.summary: Article VIII section addressing local improvement special assessments and uniform municipal taxes.
objects.plain_language: Municipal taxes and special assessments have their own constitutional structure alongside general property tax valuation.

facts.object: Originated as Neb. Const. art. IX, sec. 7 (1875); amended 1920.

relationships.note: Municipal taxes and special assessments affect taxpayer bills.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 6.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-7 Private Property and Corporate Debts
objects.summary: Article VIII section addressing liability of private property for corporate debts and exemptions for municipal/institutional property.
objects.plain_language: This is a constitutional property and exemption context section with limited direct assessment workflow use.

facts.object: Originated as Neb. Const. art. XI, sec. 4 (1875); amended and renumbered 1920.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 7.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-8 Funding Indebtedness
objects.summary: Article VIII section addressing funding of indebtedness; included for complete revenue article coverage.
objects.plain_language: This is a public-finance section, not usually an assessor workflow source.

facts.object: Originated as Neb. Const. art. IX, sec. 3 (1875); amended 1920.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 8.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-9 Claims Against State
objects.summary: Article VIII section addressing claims against the state and treasury procedure; included for complete revenue article coverage.
objects.plain_language: This is a state fiscal procedure section, not usually an assessor workflow source.

facts.object: Originated as Neb. Const. art. IX, sec. 8 (1875); amended and renumbered 1920.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 9.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-10 Grain and Seed Taxation
objects.summary: Article VIII section addressing taxation of grain and seed.
objects.plain_language: This is an agricultural/commercial property taxation section with specific grain and seed treatment.

facts.object: Originated as Neb. Const. art. IX, sec. 7A (1920); adopted 1920.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 10.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-11 Public Electrical System In-Lieu Taxes
objects.summary: Article VIII section addressing tax or in-lieu tax treatment for certain public corporations and political subdivisions engaged in electrical business.
objects.plain_language: This is the constitutional context for certain public electrical system taxes or in-lieu payments.

facts.object: Adopted 1946 via Laws 1945, constitutional amendment No. 1; amended 1958 and 1976.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 11.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-12 Tax Increment Financing
objects.summary: Article VIII section authorizing legislative powers for tax increment financing and community redevelopment.
objects.plain_language: This is the constitutional anchor for Nebraska TIF.

facts.object: Adopted 1978 via Laws 1977, LR 30; amended 2020 via Laws 2019, LR 14CA.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 12.

objects.canonical_term: Nebraska Constitution Article VIII-13 Revenue Laws Construction
objects.summary: Article VIII section preserving operation and construction of revenue laws through constitutional transition.
objects.plain_language: This is a constitutional transition/construction rule for revenue laws.

facts.object: Originated as Neb. Const. art. IX, sec. 9 (1875); amended and renumbered 1920.

source_refs.citation: Neb. Const. art. VIII, § 13.
